## Reference videos

- [Statistical Rethinking 2023 - 03 - Geocentric Models](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tNOu-SEacNU) — Richard McElreath, English. **watch first**. Watch regression written as a generative model before estimation, exactly the workflow the lab asks you to follow end to end.
- [L4: Interpretable Linear Regressions (State of Bayes Lecture Series)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fpS0NjqNHn8) — PyMC Labs, English. Watch a Bayesian linear regression being fit and its coefficients read; it supports the lab's posterior-inference part.
- [What is a posterior predictive check and why is it useful?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yDPJnV9vcHs) — Ben Lambert, English. Watch a posterior predictive check; use it for the lab step that does not stop once the chain has converged.
